bio_en: MD doctoral student (2024 cohort) at SJTU School of Medicine and a member of AI4Rad Lab. Research focuses on clinical radiology and large language model frameworks for emergency treatment recommendation and clinical decision support.
bio_cn: 上海交通大学医学院 2024 级医学博士研究生，AI4Rad Lab 成员。研究方向聚焦临床放射学，以及面向急诊治疗推荐与临床决策支持的大语言模型框架。
interests_en: Large language model frameworks for emergency treatment recommendation
interests_cn: 面向急诊治疗推荐的大语言模型框架

news_en.text: C1 pedicle screw placement risks in ponticulus posticus — a CTA simulation study — published in Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Research (IF 3.8).
